paper_findings: RamcovGX.tex:1455-1457: 'X is semi-locally simply connected iff it is semi-locally simply connected in itself' holds only in the direction slsc ⇒ slsc in itself (GX.isSLSCIn_univ_of_semilocallySimplyConnected).
